meta.title: Unfolded — the folded-paper story game, on your phones
meta.description: A party game for 2–10 friends in the same room. Write one story together, one line at a time, without seeing what came before. Then read it out loud.

hero.eyebrow: A party game for friends in the same room
hero.title: Everyone writes a line. Nobody’s to blame.
hero.lead: Write one story together on your phones. You only see the last few words before your turn, then you fold the page and pass it on. At the end, everyone reads the whole thing out loud.

sheet.mine: Natalie found an old letter under the door.
sheet.next: Inside, in tiny handwriting, it said
sheet.caption: A sheet of paper folds over the line just written, leaving only the start of the next sentence for the next player.
